description: Free check of whether Google can index a website well: Googlebot access in robots.txt and on the server, noindex, canonical, http-to-https and www redirects, the sitemap and whether its URLs answer 200, titles, meta descriptions, H1, structured data, mobile viewport, hreflang and Core Web Vitals from real Chrome users. Takes about 15-60 seconds. Returns the grade (A-F), the score and the list of problems, without fixes. When available, it also returns an Ahrefs estimate of the domain in Google (ranking keywords, monthly organic traffic, Domain Rating, referring domains). These numbers are estimates, not Search Console data, they do not affect the grade, and they are sometimes temporarily unavailable. The report is in Polish. The full report with step-by-step fixes and a PDF is sent by JustIdea Agency to the user's e-mail. Use only details the user gave you: never invent or guess an e-mail address. Before calling, tell the user the report goes to their e-mail and ask for consent under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. At most 2 scans per e-mail address per day. If it returns status "running", call get_scan_result with the scan_id after 30-60 seconds.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address. The full report with fixes is sent there, and only there.

language.description: Report language. Use "pl" for Polish-speaking users, "en" for everyone else.

name.description: Optional. The user's first name, only if they gave it.

phone.description: Optional. The user's phone number, only if they gave it and want a call about the results.

url.description: The website to scan: a domain or URL, e.g. "mystore.com". Only the home domain is used.

zgoda.description: Must be true: the user agreed to receive the report by e-mail, to be contacted by JustIdea about the results, and to the processing of this data under the privacy policy.

name: scan_google_visibility
title: Free Google visibility scan
